Global (All).summary: Riots in Iran continued for a third consecutive day (7/30/2024) with protesters defying security forces in multiple cities, including Tehran, Mashhad, and Tabriz.
Turkish military forces launched a series of airstrikes against Kurdish militant targets in northern Iraq (7/29/2024).
Protests against Indian government policies erupted in multiple cities across the country (7/27/2024), resulting in clashes with police and reports of injuries.

United States.title: US Shootings: Gun violence in the United States sees a surge in recent weeks
United States.summary: The US saw a surge in gun violence in the past week, with multiple mass shootings reported.

United States.title: Jan 6th Riot Charges: US DOJ announces charges against hundreds of January 6th riot participants
United States.summary: The US Department of Justice (DOJ) announced charges against over 800 individuals involved in the January 6th riot at the US Capitol building.

United States.title: US Border Influx: Hundreds of migrants detained at US-Mexico border in recent days
United States.summary: The US Border Patrol reported an increase in migrant detentions at the US-Mexico border over the past week, with hundreds of individuals being taken into custody.

South Korea.summary: Tensions between South Korea and North Korea increased after the North fired a ballistic missile into the sea, with the US and South Korean militaries conductingjoint drills in response.
South Korea's presidential office issued a statement urging citizens to remain calm amid rising tensions with the North.

South Korea.title: South Korean government to provide 10 billion won in support for victims of Itaewon crush
South Korea.summary: The South Korean government announced that it would provide 10 billion won ($7.4 million) in support for the victims of the deadly Itaewon crush, which occurred on October 29, 2022.

Japan.title: Japan to consider new economic measures due to Ukraine Russia conflict
Japan.summary: Japan is considering new economic measures to mitigate the impact of the Ukraine-Russia conflict, which has led to high fuel prices.

Japan.title: Japan’s ruling party to introduce 10.8 trillion yen stimulus package
Japan.summary: Japan's ruling party plans to introduce a 10.8 trillion yen ($97.3 billion) stimulus package to address economic concerns and inflation.

Japan.title: Japan’s economy shows signs of recovery, but recession fears linger
Japan.summary: Japan's economy is showing signs of recovery, but recession fears linger due to global economic uncertainty and inflation concerns.
